culture.text: Mid-sized: about 234 staff, based in Amsterdam, founded in 2009.
Many staff studied in Slovakia (Žilina, Bratislava) or at the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, mostly in IT, informatics and economics.
Builds a SaaS platform banks use for mortgages, loans, savings, investments and pensions.

open.text: OHPEN Services B.V. and OHPEN Technology B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
Its open entry-level data and analytics job at Rokin, Amsterdam does not require Dutch.
